What we fix, install and label

  • 01

    Panel replacement and labeling

    Old and overloaded panels replaced, every lug torqued to spec and every circuit labeled.

  • 02

    Aluminum wiring repair

    1960s and 1970s aluminum branch wiring made safe with rated connectors at each device.

  • 03

    Generator interlocks

    A portable generator inlet and a panel interlock, so the house runs safely in an outage.

  • 04

    Standby generators

    Natural gas standby generators with an automatic transfer switch, sized to what must keep running.

  • 05

    EV charger installation

    Level 2 chargers wired on a dedicated circuit, with the load on your panel checked first.

  • 06

    Troubleshooting and repairs

    Tripping breakers, dead outlets and dimming lights traced with a meter and written down.

  • 07

    Whole-home surge protection

    A panel-mounted surge protector for spring storms and lightning season in the Hill Country.

  • 08

    Pool and hot tub wiring

    Bonding, GFCI protection and disconnects for pools and hot tubs, inspected before the first swim.

  • 09

    Outdoor and landscape lighting

    Low-voltage path lights and outdoor GFCI outlets for patios under the live oaks.
